title: npm Package Info
description: Structured information about npm packages: details, head-to-head comparisons, alternatives, and use-case recommendations.

supportedIntents.description: A query naming exactly one npm package, asking what it is or its latest version.
A query naming two or more npm packages to compare head-to-head.
A query asking for alternatives or similar packages to one named package.
A query describing a need without naming any specific package; the component recommends suitable packages.
example: best npm package for date formatting

type.description: One of: package-details, package-compare, package-alternatives, use-case-recommendation.

filters.description: Package names resolved from the query, if any.

packageNames.description: npm package names found in the query (sourceID values).

features.description: Free-text need, used only when no package is named (e.g. 'date formatting').
